Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Birendra Singh Adhikari,
Advocate for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Dinesh Bankoti, Brief Holder for
the State of Uttarakhand/ respondent no.
1.
3. Mr. Shailendra Nauriyal, Advocate
for respondent no. 2
4. Petitioner participated in a selection
for the post of Instructor (Electrical) in
Government Industrial Training
Institutes. According to petitioner, he
qualified the written examination with
45% marks, however, he could not
submit his National Craft Instructor
Certificate (NCIC) within the window
period, which was provided by the
selecting body to all candidates.
5. Learned counsel for petitioner
submits that the said certificate was to
be submitted online between 23.11.2025
to 26.11.2025, however, petitioner was
not aware about opening of window by
the selecting body, as a result, the
certificate could not be uploaded. He,
further submits that petitioner was
awarded the certificate in 2017,
therefore, there was no other reason for
not submitting the certificate.
6. Learned counsel for the selecting
body, however, submits that all
candidates, who could not submit NCIC
certificate earlier were given an
opportunity to submit the same by

2026:UHC:4149
opening window for three days. He
submits that petitioner himself is to be
blamed for not submitting the certificate
within stipulated time, therefore,
petitioner is not entitled to any
indulgence in the matter.
7. Learned counsel for petitioner
submits that since petitioner could not
upload the NCIC certificate, online
within the window period, therefore, he
sent the certificate to the selecting body
by registered post on 01.12.2025,
however, the same is not being
considered. He submits that petitioner be
permitted to make representation to the
selecting body.
8. Learned counsel for the selecting
body submits that he has no objection if
petitioner is permitted to make
representation.
9. The writ petition is, accordingly,
disposed of by permitting petitioner to
make representation to the competent
authority. Representation, if made by
petitioner within one week, decision
thereupon shall be taken, as per law,
within three weeks. It is made clear that
opportunity, if given to petitioner to
upload NCIC certificate, then similar
opportunity shall be given to all other
candidates, who also could not upload
the certificate, by issuing a notification in
newspapers as well as in the website.
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 26.05.2026
Navin
